payload.title: Reconcile Hostinger self-hosted runner runtime eligibility before BASE receipt replay
payload.work_clay: Resolve the contradiction between the older CAPACITY_STATE Hostinger-online projection and fresh GitHub Actions observations. Query repository self-hosted runner state directly, verify the intended Hostinger runner is registered to gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity (or an allowed organization runner group), online, not busy/stale, sufficiently current, and eligible for the repository. Verify listener/service health on the Hostinger VPS if host access exists. Do not infer offline merely from a queued job. Once eligibility is verified, execute the existing read-only `.github/workflows/claycode-vps-wp02-probe.yml` path and require its constrained hosted writer to persist `research_entity/claycode/remote_vps/LATEST_WP02_STRICT.json` before any WP02/BASE remote-evidence promotion.
payload.reason_clay: GO OOB PR #56 created run 31342068951 / job 93317377631 with only `runs-on: self-hosted`; it remained QUEUED with zero steps/logs in the bounded observation. Therefore Linux/X64 extra labels are not supported as the primary blocker. Current official GitHub routing semantics say a self-hosted job remains queued when no online+idle matching eligible runner is available. CAPACITY_STATE still records the Hostinger runner as online from 2026-08-09, so the correct state is contradiction requiring live reconciliation rather than invented offline status.
payload.completion_clay: A fresh runtime receipt records repository-visible runner id/name/status/busy/labels/group/scope/version plus Hostinger listener/service status where available; then the canonical WP02 VPS workflow executes and its persisted LATEST_WP02_STRICT.json exists with wp02_pass/wp06_replay_pass fields and exact runner/runtime/dependency/source hashes. If eligibility cannot be restored, preserve the exact blocker and do not claim Ubuntu execution.
invalidators: fresh LATEST_WP02_STRICT.json already appears on main
Hostinger runner is intentionally removed/replaced by owner
